mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY')

select count(1) from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on target_dept.dept_id = #{deptId} where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY') and ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) )

select d.dept_id from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY') and (d.dept_id = #{deptId} or find_in_set(#{deptId}, d.ancestors)) order by case when d.dept_id = #{deptId} then 0 else 1 end, d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id
select d.dept_name from sys_dept d where d.dept_id = #{deptId} and d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY') limit 1

select distinct target_dept.dept_id, target_dept.dept_name, target_dept.dept_type, target_dept.parent_id from sys_user_shop us inner join sys_dept scope_dept on scope_dept.dept_id = us.dept_id inner join sys_dept target_dept on ( target_dept.dept_id = scope_dept.dept_id or find_in_set(scope_dept.dept_id, target_dept.ancestors) ) where us.user_id = #{userId} and scope_dept.del_flag = '0' and scope_dept.status = '0' and scope_dept.dept_type in ('GROUP', 'COMPANY', 'STORE', 'WAREHOUSE') and target_dept.del_flag = '0' and target_dept.status = '0' and target_dept.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY') order by target_dept.dept_type, target_dept.parent_id, target_dept.dept_name, target_dept.dept_id

select d.dept_id, d.dept_name, d.dept_type, d.parent_id from sys_dept d where d.del_flag = '0' and d.status = '0' and d.dept_type in ('STORE', 'COMPANY') order by d.dept_type, d.parent_id, d.order_num, d.dept_id
